description: Return a plan's status, version, whether its included revision is used, its customer-facing order reference, and progress (essential shots ticked, next shot, when the last tick was made). Read-only. Use the full taskId from shoot_plan_list (not planId). A unique eight-character task prefix or orderReference also works. Connections see only their own live or owner-test plans.
name: shoot_plan_status
title: Check a plan's progress
